notes.title: UPDATE 0.5.6
notes.notes:
Hi there ,

Sorry for the delay since the last update, I was sick and being solo on this adventure delayed everything.
The next updates will arrive at a frequency of once every 2 weeks.

In this update, the following has been changed:

-Added a minimap usable in the "world"(disabled in dungeons and shops)

-Added a more sober loading screen with random hints.

-Added a new exotic food slot to complete the quest "Queen's Hunger"

-Fixed a bug that could cause some "memories" to reappear after loading.


In the next update will be added the base of the crafting system, usable in the cities and certain points of interest in the form of an alchemy workshop as well as the redesign of the menus if everything is ready.

notes.title: UPDATE 0.5.5
notes.notes:
Hello,

Following various feedback, here is an update that adds essential elements to the game to bring you more comfort.

- Added teleport points to have less movement between quests.

- Added footstep sounds.

- For the demo, all characters can use all their active skills from the start of the game.

- The title screen now adapts to the screen resolution (16:9).

- Fixed an issue where sometimes the cursor could disappear.

- Fixed arachnid dialog that could loop.

- Fixed item name for main quest in quest log: golem rune instead of golem heart.

- Fixed some floating rocks that could reach the player.

- Fixed and modified some dialog boxes as well as the getting started tutorial.


For the next updates, here is a short-term roadmap (changes within a month)


-Added a mini-map with points of interest. (within 1 to 2 weeks)

-Added several quests in the Forgotten Realm as well as points of interest. (less than 1-2 weeks)

-Added a better loading screen that includes hints. (within 1 to 2 weeks)

-Addition of the basic crafting system, it will allow the creation of consumable objects to boost you in combat or to complete quests. (within 2-4 weeks)

- Complete overhaul of the menus for better ergonomics. (within 2-4 weeks)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.5.4
notes.notes:
Hello,

For the version 0.5.4 update, some adjustments have been made:

- Fixed a bug disabling random fights following update 0.5.3. done earlier in the day.

- adjustments to damage dealt by enemies on the rise.

- modification of the keys for more intuitive commands, in particular of the main menu.

Another update with minor fixes and additions will be made this weekend.
